spans.s:
n. (हृत् or हृद्)
1 The heart.
2 The mind, the faculty or seat of thought and feeling.
E.
हृ to take, aff. क्विप्, and तुक् added; or हृद् substituted for the following.

n. (-यं)
1 The mind, the seat or faculty of thought and feeling.
2 The heart.
3 Knowledge.
E.
हृ to take, कयन् Uṇādi aff., and दुक् augment.

mfn. (-ही-हिणी-हि)
Captivating, engaging the affections.
E.
हृदय, and ग्राहिन् taking.

mfn. (-मः-मा-मं)
1 Apposite and proper, (as speech.)
2 Affecting, touching.
3 Dear, beloved.
E.
हृदय the heart, गम to go, खश् aff.

mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्)
Good-hearted, kind, humane.
E.
हृदय the heart, and मतुप् aff.

n. (-नं)
The breast, the chest.
E.
हृदय the heart, and स्थान place.

m. (-त्मा)
A heron.
E.
हृदय the heart, and आत्मन् self.

mfn. (-लुः-लुः-लु)
Good-hearted.
E.
हृदय the heart, and आलुच् aff.

mfn. (-त् or द्)
Heart-piercing.
E.
हृदय, and आविध् what pierces.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Good-hearted.
E.
हृदय the heart, and ठन् aff.

mfn. (-यी-यिनी-यि)
Good-hearted.
E.
हृदय the heart, and इनि poss. aff.

m. (-शः)
1 A husband.
2 A wife.
E.
हृदय the heart, and ईश lord.

mfn. (-ङ्कः-ङ्का-ङ्कं)
Heart-heaving, distressing.
E.
हृदय, उत् up, अंक what goes.

m. (-र्त्तः)
A curl or lock of hair on a horse's neck, or breast.
E.
हृद् the heart, and आवर्त्त a twist.

mfn. (-स्पृक)
Dear, beloved, cherished.
E.
हृदि in the heart, and स्पृश् what effects.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Conceived, come to mind, designed.
E.
हृद्, and गत gone.

m. (-लः)
The name of a mountainous district.

m. pl. (-याः)
The military inhabitants of the Hṛdgola mountains.
E.
हृद्गोल as above, छ aff.

m. (-शः)
The heart or the region of it.
E.
हृद्, देश place.

mfn. (-द्यः-द्या-द्यं)
1 Dear, beloved, cherished, desired.
2 Grateful, pleasant, agreeable.
3 Produced in or from the heart.
4 Affectionate, kind.
m. (-द्यः)
A Mantra of the Vedas for effecting any one's subjection or fascination.
f. (-द्या)
Vṛddhi, a medicinal root, so named.
n. (-द्यं)
Cassia bark.
E.
हृद् the heart, यत् aff.

m. (-न्धः)
The Bel tree, (Ægle marmelos.)
n. (-न्धं)
1 Small cardamoms.
2 Sochal salt.
f. (-न्धा)
Great-flowered jasmine.
E.
हृद्य agreeable, and गन्ध smell.

f. (-ता)
Agreeableness, delightfulness.
E.
हृद्य, and तल् aff.; also with त्व, हृद्यत्वं.

m. (-गः)
1 Heart-burn.
2 Any disease of the heart.
E.
हृद् the heart, and रोग disease; also हृदयरोग.

m. (-री)
A tree, (Pentaptera Arjuna.)
E.
हृद्रोग the heart-burn, and वैरिन् hostile.

m. (-कः)
The stomach.
E.
हृद् the heart, and वण्टक a part.
